items.quote: Jusel did an amazing job. Very thorough conscientious and meticulous on details. All at a very reasonable price (especially materials which were all superior quality and for less than HD would charge for the same or lesser products). I highly recommend him to anyone needing trim work.

I wanted to change an interior billfold door to a lockable hundred door. I received several recommendations from chat GPT. Out of that I picked Jusel. He did a great job and was punctual for the appointment.
I can't say enough good things about Jusel and his team. They completely transformed our pool lanai ceiling, and the finished product exceeded every expectation. The craftsmanship is outstanding.
